goblin_ear_thyme_canape.name: Goblin Ear Canape with Wild Thyme
goblin_ear_thyme_canape.description: Thinly sliced goblin ear cartilage seared over thyme branches. The ridged texture sharpens the diner's own hearing for hours.
goblin_ear_thyme_canape.sprite_desc: A small wooden board with thin curling slices of pale greenish ear meat fanned over fresh thyme sprigs, drizzled with brown jus

stone_moss_celery_tisane.name: Stone Moss and Pale Celery Tisane
stone_moss_celery_tisane.description: Petrified moss steeped with pale celery in slow-simmered broth. The earthen mineral note lingers and steadies the mind.
stone_moss_celery_tisane.sprite_desc: A pale stone cup of cloudy moss-green tisane with curled celery ribbons and flecks of grey moss floating at the surface

witch_finger_nightshade_terrine.name: Witch Finger Terrine
witch_finger_nightshade_terrine.description: Witch finger bone pressed with nightshade leaf into a dark terrine. Bitter, sharp, and unsettlingly clarifying.
witch_finger_nightshade_terrine.sprite_desc: A glossy black terrine slice on a slate plate, ringed by violet nightshade leaves, a single pale finger-bone fragment protruding

serpent_venom_pepper_reduction.name: Sable Serpent Venom Reduction
serpent_venom_pepper_reduction.description: Sable serpent venom carefully neutralized in a reduction of serpent pepper and wine. Bright heat, no bite.
serpent_venom_pepper_reduction.sprite_desc: A small obsidian dish holding a glistening crimson reduction, a coiled garnish of pepper husk perched on the rim

patriarch_signet_rosemary_consomme.name: Patriarch Signet Consomme
patriarch_signet_rosemary_consomme.description: The seal-ring of an iron patriarch melted into clear consomme, infused with rosemary. The dish carries an air of solemn authority.
patriarch_signet_rosemary_consomme.sprite_desc: A polished pewter bowl holding a clear amber broth, a faintly molten signet ring resting at the bottom, rosemary sprig floating

assassin_cowl_valerian_dumplings.name: Cowl-Wrapped Valerian Dumplings
assassin_cowl_valerian_dumplings.description: Dumplings wrapped in fibres torn from a slain mage-slayer's cowl, stuffed with valerian. The diner fades from notice as they eat.
assassin_cowl_valerian_dumplings.sprite_desc: Three dark cloth-wrapped dumplings on a black slate plate, dusted with grey ash, faintly translucent at the edges

golem_core_mushroom_pottage.name: Golem Core Pottage
golem_core_mushroom_pottage.description: The animating sigil-stone of a stone golem ground into a thick mushroom pottage. Heavy, mineral, and unshakable.
golem_core_mushroom_pottage.sprite_desc: A heavy clay bowl of dense grey-brown pottage with chunks of mushroom and a single faintly glowing stone shard at center

plague_phylactery_garlic_broth.name: Plague Phylactery Cleansing Broth
plague_phylactery_garlic_broth.description: A plague witch's phylactery cracked and boiled into broth with valerian root. The sickness it once held now wards the diner from poison.
plague_phylactery_garlic_broth.sprite_desc: A pitted iron bowl of milky greenish broth with a cracked black phylactery shell at the bottom, faint sickly vapors rising

vine_essence_thyme_salad.name: Vine Essence and Thyme Salad
vine_essence_thyme_salad.description: Tendrils of vine horror dressed raw over wild thyme. The plant's hunger for sunlight is repurposed as the eater's hunger for healing.
vine_essence_thyme_salad.sprite_desc: A wooden salad bowl piled with twisting deep-green vine tendrils, thyme sprigs, and a glossy oil dressing

horror_ichor_void_salt_souffle.name: Horror Ichor Souffle
horror_ichor_void_salt_souffle.description: Lurking-horror ichor folded into egg with a pinch of void salt. The souffle quivers between visible and not.
horror_ichor_void_salt_souffle.sprite_desc: A trembling pale-violet souffle in a ceramic ramekin, faintly translucent crust, tiny dark flecks of salt scattered on top

sentinel_plate_mandrake_steak.name: Sentinel Plate Steak
sentinel_plate_mandrake_steak.description: A slab of throne-sentinel armor scale slow-braised with mandrake root until tender. Eats like steel and protects like steel.
sentinel_plate_mandrake_steak.sprite_desc: A square dark-grey scale of meat-textured plate on a stone slab, halved to show pinkish marbling, mandrake garnish

lich_dust_nightshade_dust_loaf.name: Lich Dust Funeral Loaf
lich_dust_nightshade_dust_loaf.description: Powdered remains of a skeleton-lich kneaded into a dark loaf with nightshade. Dense with arcane memory.
lich_dust_nightshade_dust_loaf.sprite_desc: A dense black loaf on a funerary stone, sliced to reveal grey marbling and dark purple leaf flecks throughout

demon_horn_ember_skewer.name: Demon Horn and Ember Skewer
demon_horn_ember_skewer.description: Spirals of trickster-demon horn grilled until charred, dusted with ember spice. Each bite burns and bolsters.
demon_horn_ember_skewer.sprite_desc: A blackened iron skewer of spiraling charred horn pieces glowing with embers, fine red spice dusted along the length

deep_pearl_celery_chowder.name: Deep Pearl Abyssal Chowder
deep_pearl_celery_chowder.description: A deep-one priest's pearl cracked and stewed with pale celery in milk-thick broth. The diner hears the tide in the back of their skull.
deep_pearl_celery_chowder.sprite_desc: A bone-white bowl of pale milky chowder, halved iridescent pearl resting on top, celery ribbons curling around it

crone_voice_valerian_tea.name: Crone Voice Whispering Tea
crone_voice_valerian_tea.description: The harvested whisper-organ of a crone steeped in valerian. The tea murmurs faint advice as it is sipped.
crone_voice_valerian_tea.sprite_desc: A black clay teacup of murky violet tea, faintly luminous vapor rising in shapes that almost resemble script

mimic_gold_ember_glaze.name: Glazed Mimic Gold Bites
mimic_gold_ember_glaze.description: Coin-shaped flesh of a gilded mimic glazed in ember spice until the metallic sheen runs. You never know which faculty it sharpens.
mimic_gold_ember_glaze.sprite_desc: Six small disc-shaped golden bites on a dark plate, each wearing a glossy red glaze, faint coin-faces visible beneath

necromantic_focus_mandrake_terrine.name: Necromantic Focus Terrine
necromantic_focus_mandrake_terrine.description: A crypt-summoner's focus crystal layered with mandrake root in a chilled terrine. Cold to the tongue, cold to the soul, lucid to the mind.
necromantic_focus_mandrake_terrine.sprite_desc: A rectangular slice of dark layered terrine on slate, a faintly glowing purple crystal core visible in cross-section

rime_tusk_frost_glaze.name: Rime Tusk Frost-Glazed Cut
rime_tusk_frost_glaze.description: A frostfang giant's tusk shaved and glazed with frost-gland ice. The cold settles in the bones and pushes other cold away.
rime_tusk_frost_glaze.sprite_desc: Pale shaved tusk-meat curls fanned across a frosted stone plate, glistening with bluish ice crystals

shadow_quiver_void_skewer.name: Shadow Quiver Skewer
shadow_quiver_void_skewer.description: Arrow-shafts of woven shadow grilled briefly and salted with void salt. The diner's hand learns the quiver's quickness.
shadow_quiver_void_skewer.sprite_desc: A row of slender dark shaft-shaped skewer pieces on charred iron, dusted with crystalline black salt, faintly indistinct edges

inquisitor_seal_rosemary_loaf.name: Inquisitor Seal Loaf
inquisitor_seal_rosemary_loaf.description: A veiled inquisitor's wax seal kneaded into a heavy loaf with rosemary. The diner sees clearly what others would hide.
inquisitor_seal_rosemary_loaf.sprite_desc: A heavy oblong loaf with a deep red wax seal pressed into the crust, a sprig of rosemary tucked beside it

elemental_core_dragon_salt_consomme.name: Elemental Core Consomme
elemental_core_dragon_salt_consomme.description: A lava-elemental's molten core clarified into searing consomme with dragon salt. The eater carries inner flame for an hour.
elemental_core_dragon_salt_consomme.sprite_desc: A black iron bowl of glowing orange consomme, faintly bubbling, a single white-hot core fragment sinking at center

archon_heart_mandrake_braise.name: Archon Heart Braise
archon_heart_mandrake_braise.description: The blood archon's heart braised in red wine with mandrake. A meal of imperial weight, lifting both body and bearing.
archon_heart_mandrake_braise.sprite_desc: A heavy crimson roast on a brass platter swimming in dark wine sauce, mandrake roots fanned around the rim

astral_filament_silk_consomme.name: Astral Filament Consomme
astral_filament_silk_consomme.description: Threads of an astral horror spun together with cave spider silk into a translucent broth. The diner's thoughts walk further than their feet.
astral_filament_silk_consomme.sprite_desc: A glass bowl of nearly transparent broth, suspended within it a fine silvery web of intersecting filaments

swarmlord_chitin_pepper_crisps.name: Swarmlord Chitin Crisps
swarmlord_chitin_pepper_crisps.description: Locust-swarmlord plate fried into shattering crisps, dusted with serpent pepper. The eater's reflexes hum like a swarm.
swarmlord_chitin_pepper_crisps.sprite_desc: A ceramic plate piled with translucent amber crisps the shape of insect plating, dusted bright red, faintly buzzing

executioners_iron_void_steak.name: Executioner's Iron Steak
executioners_iron_void_steak.description: A pit executioner's iron rendered down into a black steak crusted with void salt. Eats like guilt, strikes like judgment.
executioners_iron_void_steak.sprite_desc: A dark slab of iron-black steak on a stained block, charred crust glittering with crystalline black salt

void_feather_thyme_souffle.name: Void Feather Souffle
void_feather_thyme_souffle.description: A void seraph's feather whipped into a souffle over wild thyme. The diner's sight reaches places light cannot.
void_feather_thyme_souffle.sprite_desc: A tall dark-grey souffle in a white ramekin, faintly absorbing light at the edges, thyme sprig laid across the crust

herald_trumpet_brass_glaze.name: Herald Trumpet Brass Glaze
herald_trumpet_brass_glaze.description: An apocalypse herald's trumpet mouthpiece glazed in ember spice and roasted whole. Each bite peals through the body like a distant horn.
herald_trumpet_brass_glaze.sprite_desc: A polished brass mouthpiece roasted to deep amber on a red-glowing iron platter, ember spice flickering across the surface

wormwood_ash_valerian_loaf.name: Wormwood Ash Bitter Loaf
wormwood_ash_valerian_loaf.description: Ash of a wormwood blight kneaded with valerian root into a black, bitter loaf. The mind clears the way a fire-cleared field clears.
wormwood_ash_valerian_loaf.sprite_desc: A scorched-black loaf on a stone slab, fissures glowing faintly red, pale valerian flowers pressed into the crust

horseman_lance_shard_grand_feast.name: Horseman Lance Shard Grand Feast
horseman_lance_shard_grand_feast.description: An iron horseman's shattered lance shard plated with dragon scale and ember spice. The grandest of late-game feasts; the diner rides into battle.
horseman_lance_shard_grand_feast.sprite_desc: An ornate brass platter laden with a long iron shard centerpiece, ringed by glittering dragon-scale crisps and red-spice flames
